desc_short: Bank of America Stadium: open football bowl with light blue seats in two tiers, black steel upper rim, glass and steel corner towers, gray concrete exterior, green field
Nissan Stadium: open football bowl with navy blue seats in two decks, tall light towers over the sideline, tan and red brick exterior, end zone video board
State Farm Stadium: rounded barrel-shaped stadium clad in vertical ribbed silver metal panels with glass slots, translucent retractable roof panels on top
NRG Stadium: rectangular football stadium with a light translucent retractable roof on two large steel trusses, glass curtain walls, red and tan base
